native_title: 我与古董先生的契约之恋

titles.title: 我与古董先生的契约之恋

description:
Juyeon has a big concern these days. Her dad who is a famous antique appraiser left home and fences and gang members break into his shop trying to steal everything he owns. Then, suddenly a man named Doggabi appears and says that he will protect Juyeon from any danger if she signs a contract with him. Juyeon reluctantly signs the contract but after that, she starts hearing the voices of antiques whenever Doggabi is near her. Juyeon, a girl who must find one special treasure to protect her father’s shop, starts living with this mysterious man named Doggabi.
